objects.description: [menuPass](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0045) has encoded strings in its malware with base64 as well as with a simple, single-byte XOR obfuscation using key 0x40.(Citation: Accenture Hogfish April 2018)(Citation: FireEye APT10 Sept 2018)(Citation: Symantec Cicada November 2020)

(Citation: Accenture Hogfish April 2018) (Citation: FireEye APT10 Sept 2018) (Citation: Symantec Cicada November 2020)
